newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P lowers Tri Polyta rating to B-plus.
newsitem.headline: S&P lowers Tri Polyta rating to B-plus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said it has lowered its long-term corporate credit rating on Tri Polyta Indoesnesia Tbk (P.T.) to B-plus from BB-minus.
It has also lowered Tri Ployta Finance B.V.'s US$185 million guaranteed secured by the same amount, and has revised its outlook to negative from stable.
S&P said the downgrade reflected the company's much weaker than expected operating performance and greater margin volatility in recent months.

The outlook revision reflected S&P's expectation that conditions generally would continue to be difficult for non-integrated polypropylene producers for the short to medium term in the Asian region, which might cause Tri Polyta's finance to deteriorate further.
